selection.name: C08 — agentmemory (rohitg00)
selection.role: Unranked, provisional finalist for the sole memory owner.

basis.shows: Documents shared Claude/Codex hooks and MCP, handoffs, lessons, provenance inspection, deletion with an audit trail, export/import and snapshots. Explicitly documents Linux x86_64, WSL2 and macOS arm64. Default BM25 retrieval needs no GPU.

Reports LongMemEval-S retrieval R@5 of 95.2% over 500 questions and 86.2% with BM25 fallback, plus a passing-test badge. Raw results and CI runs were not inspected; these claims do not establish comparative superiority or complete recovery.

selection.name: C04 — agent-memory (tigerless-labs)
selection.role: Unranked, provisional finalist for the sole memory owner.
selection.install_command:
git clone https://github.com/tigerless-labs/agent-memory.git
cd agent-memory
uv sync --all-packages
export PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH"
mem init
mem setup --host claude-code
mem setup --host codex

basis.shows: Documents one Claude/Codex store, project-scoped decisions, authoritative Markdown, disposable SQLite indexes and archived source traces. Deletion ends current validity while preserving historical records; index rebuilding is documented. This establishes auditability, not permanent erasure or tested disaster recovery.

Reports a bounded 120-episode evaluation with two replays: 127/240 versus MemCore's 86/240, and passing checks for nine ordered cross-client writer-reader pairs. Documents pytest, Ruff and mypy commands. Requires Python 3.12+ and uv; exact target-platform CI remains unverified. MIT license.

selection.name: C15 — Basic Memory
selection.role: Unranked, provisional finalist for the sole memory owner.

basis.shows: Documents authoritative Markdown, scoped projects, shared Claude/Codex MCP access, inspectable writes and deletion tools. Its Claude plugin supplies session briefings and compaction checkpoints. Local backup is user-managed; reindexing and consistency checks are documented.

Documents SQLite/Postgres test suites and agent-package checks, without verified current CI results or comparable recall measurements. Python/uv installation is documented; WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution were not verified. The current install requires a transitive prerelease. AGPL-3.0 license.

layers.deciding_comparison: No final winner is established. The selections are alternative sole owners, not a combined installation. Compare agentmemory, tigerless agent-memory and Basic Memory pairwise on the WSL2 host; ai-memory and Hindsight remain credible challengers pending lifecycle verification. Use the same source corpus, scoped projects and inference budget with complete upstream-supported configurations. Measure grounded recall, abstention, useful-write quality, cross-client handoffs, scope leakage, deletion across derived state, and restore into an isolated empty environment. Repeat portability checks on macOS arm64. The packet's 470-question comparison cannot decide this: capture, embedders and versions differed, and ai-memory's reranker was disabled.
evidence_gaps: Required ctx_fetch_and_index and ctx_search tools were unavailable. Accessible primary sources were read through the web tool instead.
GitHub shell access failed, and public API endpoints were inaccessible through the web tool. Default-branch commits, exact pins, latest releases and archived status could not be verified.

The required currency window is 2026-07-03 through 2026-10-01. No complete activity audit was possible. Indexed ai-memory release and deja-vu changelog timestamps provide partial evidence only; crawl dates were not treated as repository activity.
Issue responsiveness, current passing CI, scope enforcement and isolated recovery were not verified consistently across candidates.
README evaluation numbers are upstream-reported evidence, not independently reproduced results; raw benchmark outputs and paper pages were not inspected.
Selected install commands follow retrieved default-branch documentation and are unpinned. No installation or host test was performed.
No candidate was excluded because none of the closed exclusion criteria was established.
Budget used: 6 web searches and 8 repository-page fetches; failed API attempts remained below the 30-call limit.
